comments.author: Rufas
comments.body:
Correct quest name: "Pineapple as an appetizer"
Description: "The Lima barkeep is apparently thinking about selling snacks made with pineapples and is requesting the delivery of some. Please taken him 5 barrels worth for now. Pineapples are grown in the Caribbean so it might be easiest if you use the Panama Canal and buy them in Panama."
